summary.zh: 為美業商家打造整合LINE的線上預約、會員與POS管理系統。
summary.en: An all-in-one LINE-integrated booking, membership and POS platform for beauty businesses.

overview.zh: 夯客（hotcake）協助美髮、美甲美睫、健身瑜伽、醫美等美業商家，快速建立串接LINE官方帳號的專屬預約、會員與POS系統。平台已導入超過二千家商家，並切入精準再行銷與數據驅動營運等AI應用。
overview.en: Hunger (hotcake) helps salons, nail and lash studios, fitness and medical-aesthetic businesses quickly build dedicated booking, membership and POS systems tied to their LINE official accounts. The platform serves over two thousand merchants and is expanding into AI-driven precision remarketing and data-led operations.

summary.zh: 以生成式AI打造先進封裝EDA工具，模擬異質整合晶片系統。
summary.en: Builds a generative-AI advanced-packaging EDA tool that simulates heterogeneous-integration chip systems.

overview.zh: 煊程科技由成功大學工程科學系游濟華副教授團隊創立，針對半導體異質整合封裝開發「先進封裝EDA工具」。核心為「模擬＋生成式AI」整合運算系統，能自我生成資料庫，在不需巨量資料庫的情況下達到深度學習效果，快速產出符合需求的封裝解決方案。
overview.en: Hsuan-Cheng Technology was founded by a team led by Associate Professor Chi-Hua Yu of National Cheng Kung University's Department of Engineering Science. It develops an advanced-packaging EDA tool for semiconductor heterogeneous integration, built on an integrated simulation-plus-generative-AI engine that self-generates its database to reach deep-learning performance without a massive pre-built dataset, rapidly producing packaging solutions.

summary.en: Taiwan's first private qualified power trader, operating a virtual power plant from distributed energy resources.

overview.zh: 安瑟樂威是台灣首家民營合格交易者，整合需量反應、儲能與再生能源等分散式資源，建構虛擬電廠參與電力輔助服務市場與綠電交易。提供一站式能源規劃、24小時調度與系統整合服務，協助企業最大化能源資產收益並強化電網韌性。
overview.en: Ancillary Power is Taiwan's first private qualified power trader. It aggregates demand response, energy storage and renewables into a virtual power plant that participates in the ancillary-services market and green-power trading. The company offers one-stop energy planning, 24/7 dispatch and system integration to help enterprises maximize returns on energy assets and strengthen grid resilience.
